#Practical Application of Built-in Functions
```{r}

student_marks <- c(65, 72, 80, 85, 90, 68, 75, 95, 88, 78)

student_marks

```

# Calculating the Total Mark
```{r}
sum(student_marks)
```
#Calculating the Average Marks
```{r}
mean(student_marks)
```
#The max() function identifies the highest mark recorded
```{r}
max(student_marks)
```

#The min() function identifies the lowest mark in the dataset.
```{r}
min(student_marks)
```
#The sort() function arranges the marks in ascending order.
```{r}
sort(student_marks)
```
# Calculating Standard Deviation
```{r}
sd(student_marks)
```

#Creating User-Defined Functions in R
```{r}
function_name <- function(arguments) {
  statements
  return(result)
}
```
#Creating a Function to Calculate the Average
```{r}
calculate_average <- function(marks) {
  average <- mean(marks)
  return(average)
}

marks <- c(60, 75, 80, 85, 95)

calculate_average(marks)
```
#Creating a Function with Multiple Arguments
```{r}
add_values <- function(first_number, second_number) {
  result <- first_number + second_number
  return(result)
}

add_values(25, 35)
```
#This function calculates the area of a rectangle using its length and width.
```{r}
calculate_area <- function(length, width) {
  area <- length * width
  return(area)
}

calculate_area(12, 8)
```
#Creating a Function with Default Arguments
```{r}
welcome_student <- function(name = "Data Big data analytics Student") {
  message <- paste("Welcome", name)
  return(message)
}

welcome_student()
```
#Creating a Function to Calculate a Discounted Price
```{r}
calculate_discount <- function(price, discount) {
  final_price <- price - discount
  return(final_price)
}

calculate_discount(200, 30)
```
#Creating a Function to Calculate the Total of Multiple Values
```{r}
calculate_total <- function(numbers) {
  total <- sum(numbers)
  return(total)
}

sales <- c(150, 250, 300, 200)

calculate_total(sales)
```

```{r}
calculate_statistics <- function(data) {

  results <- c(
    Mean = mean(data, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(data, na.rm = TRUE),
    Minimum = min(data, na.rm = TRUE),
    Maximum = max(data, na.rm = TRUE),
    Standard_Deviation = sd(data, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  return(results)
}

calculate_statistics(student_marks)
```
